name: spa-kit
description: Factory for client SPAs that classic search crawlers and AI answer engines can both read: generator, design tokens, and three independent verification oracles.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tools/seo/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tools/breaker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tools/e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.skill:install: rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/spa-kit && cp -R skills/spa-kit ~/.claude/skills/spa-kit && echo 'skill installed at ~/.claude/skills/spa-kit'
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run self-test
